whatIsIt.eli5: Two cheap pattern finders in a row, plus a shortcut.
whatIsIt.simple: A Bottleneck built from two DSConvs (3×3 then 5×5 or 7×7 kernels), with a residual add.
whatIsIt.engineer: DSConv(k1) → DSConv(k2, d2), residual if c1 == c2.

whyExists.simple: Depthwise-separable convs make large kernels affordable.
whyExists.engineer: Large receptive field at low cost.

engineer: k1 = 3, k2 = 7 in DSC3k2 by default.
